texts.orig: Hypothesis D. The level curves Re ( η ( s )) = 0 are differentiable. This is automatic except at isolated points where η ′ ( s ) = 0, so we are really assuming that when η ′ ( s ) = 0, arg ( η ( s )) = ± π /2. This prevents the level curves from branching. Hypothesis D is plausible because ± π /2 are only two points on the unit circle, while the zeros of η ′ ( s ) form a countable set.
